semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Hirokawa specializes in machining plastic materials used in semiconductor manufacturing, but does not directly supply semiconductor components or materials.
summary: Hirokawa specializes in the machining of plastic materials, providing processed samples for various industries including semiconductor and LCD. They utilize advanced machining technologies to create high-precision components, particularly focusing on complex shapes and micro-machining.
capabilities: Production of thin and slender structures
Utilization of advanced CNC and CAD/CAM systems

regional_presence.Japan: Hirokawa is located in Yonezawa City, Yamagata Prefecture, Japan, where it operates its manufacturing facilities.
